//: Prompt registry config for the BiggiePockets review workflow.
Every review runs BOTH arms as independent Claude passes over the same Codex
findings, so the two summary formats can be compared side-by-side on the same
PR. prompts/<name>.md are versioned templates; shared rule blocks live in
prompts/_shared/ and are injected via {{@path}} markers. Prompt versions are
derived from file content by scripts/resolve-prompts.sh, never listed here.
gate_arm names the arm whose verdict is posted as the official approve /
request-changes review (the experiment only changes presentation, never the
decision); 'control' is the trusted production prompt.
Operations: Roll = edit a prompt file (its derived version bumps). Apply = set
gate_arm or swap an arm's prompt (no version change). Split = add a new arm
entry + prompt file. Merge = fold a variant into another prompt file.
